Authorize and direct the Director of General Services, the County Administrative Officer, the Clerk of the Board, and their respective designees, to take all necessary actions to carry out the foregoing resolution; and e. The sale of the property shall be subject to approval by County Counsel, as to legal form, and by the Auditor-Controller/Treasurer-Tax Collector as to accounting form
